verdict.rationale: Quo's own documentation shows in-product AI insights: recorded calls are transcribed and summarized, and plans include AI call tags. Summaries requested through the MCP or Claude/ChatGPT connectors happen in an external agent, not inside Quo, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, insights across aggregate data beyond individual calls, depth documentation of the AI tagging and summary features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
